title: get_form_context_by_form_token selects rc.form_token but no handler reads it; the comment's justification is false
evidence: get_form_context_by_form_token.sql:9-10: '-- form_token itself is selected: the resend flow needs the CURRENT token to' / '-- build the fresh form URL after a remint.'; sql:15: '       rc.form_token,'; sql.gleam:186: '    form_token: Option(String),'; form_handler.gleam:503: '  let new_token = wisp.random_string(48)'; form_handler.gleam:603: '      form_token: new_token,'; grep across server/src/reference_checks/ finds no reader of the row's form_token field (only form_token_expires_at is read, at form_handler.gleam:530).
detail: The resend flow mints the replacement token itself (wisp.random_string(48)) and passes it to RefereeContext as new_token, so the selected rc.form_token column and its codegen'd field are never consumed. The comment's stated reason is inaccurate; the SELECT is dead weight on every context read.
recommended_fix: Drop rc.form_token from the SELECT, the form_token field + decoder entry from GetFormContextByFormTokenRow, and correct the comment to say the handler mints the replacement token (wisp.random_string(48)).
